# Hands-Free Language Coach

> Learn a language by voice alone: the coach says a phrase, you say it back, it listens and scores you, and moves on. No tapping, no screen. Streaks, XP and spaced review like a language game, free in your browser, plus a skill for Claude and ChatGPT voice mode.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
